### `GCVacuity.lean`

```lean
import GCMain

/-!
Non-vacuity checks for the definitions of the statement.
* the long and short arcs are the two arcs of the great circle between `u` and `v`;
  the long arc contains `-u` and `-v` (so it is longer than π), the short arc does not;
* the star `K_{1,3}` (a tree with a vertex of degree three) is great-circle thrackleable;
* the spider with three legs of length three is not an augmented caterpillar;
* the one-edge tree `K₂` is great-circle thrackleable but not an augmented caterpillar
  under the literal Definition 3.1 (its spine has no internal vertex), which is why the
  statement is for trees with at least three vertices.
-/

namespace GC
open SimpleGraph SimpleGraph.Walk

/-! ### Arcs -/

lemma shortArc_comm (u v : E3) : shortArc u v = shortArc v u := by
  ext z; constructor <;> rintro ⟨hs, α, β, hα, hβ, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨hs, β, α, hβ, hα, add_comm _ _⟩

lemma greatCircle_comm (u v : E3) : greatCircle u v = greatCircle v u := by
  ext z; constructor <;> rintro ⟨hs, α, β, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨hs, β, α, add_comm _ _⟩

lemma longArc_comm (u v : E3) : longArc u v = longArc v u := by
  ext z; simp only [longArc, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, greatCircle_comm u v, shortArc_comm u v]; tauto

/-- The short and long arcs together make up the great circle. -/
lemma shortArc_union_longArc (u v : E3) : shortArc u v ∪ longArc u v = greatCircle u v := by
  ext z; constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact shortArc_sub_gc h
    · exact h.1
  · intro h
    by_cases hs : z ∈ shortArc u v
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h, Or.inl hs⟩

/-- The short and long arcs meet exactly in the endpoints. -/
lemma shortArc_inter_longArc {u v : E3} (hu : u ∈ S2) (hv : v ∈ S2) :
    shortArc u v ∩ longArc u v = {u, v} := by
  ext z; constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, -, h | h | h⟩
    · exact absurd hs h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨⟨hu, 1, 0, by norm_num, le_rfl, by simp⟩, left_mem_longArc hu⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨hv, 0, 1, le_rfl, by norm_num, by simp⟩, right_mem_longArc hv⟩

/-- The antipodes of the endpoints lie on the long arc and not on the short arc. -/
lemma antipodes_long_not_short {u v t : E3} (hu : u ∈ S2) (hv : v ∈ S2) (hd : det3 u v t ≠ 0) :
    -u ∈ longArc u v ∧ -v ∈ longArc u v ∧ -u ∉ shortArc u v ∧ -v ∉ shortArc u v := by
  have h1 := neg_left_mem_longArc hu hd
  have h2 := neg_right_mem_longArc hv hd
  refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h1.2 with h' | h' | h'
    · exact h' h
    · exact ne_neg_of_S2 hu h'.symm
    · -- -u = v would make the determinant vanish
      apply hd; rw [← h']; simp only [det3, PiLp.neg_apply]; ring
  · intro h
    rcases h2.2 with h' | h' | h'
    · exact h' h
    · apply hd; rw [← h']; simp only [det3, PiLp.neg_apply]; ring
    · exact ne_neg_of_S2 hv h'.symm

/-! ### The star `K_{1,3}` is great-circle thrackleable -/

/-- The star with centre 0 and leaves 1, 2, 3. -/
abbrev star3 : SimpleGraph (Fin 4) := graphOfEdges 4 [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3)]

/-- Two short arcs from a common endpoint meet only there. -/
lemma shortArc_inter_shortArc {c a b : E3} (hc : c ∈ S2) (hd : det3 c a b ≠ 0) :
    ∃! z, z ∈ shortArc c a ∧ z ∈ shortArc c b := by
  refine ⟨c, ⟨⟨hc, 1, 0, by norm_num, le_rfl, by simp⟩, ⟨hc, 1, 0, by norm_num, le_rfl, by simp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨⟨hz, α, β, hα, hβ, rfl⟩, ⟨-, γ, δ, hγ, hδ, h⟩⟩
  have e1 := congrArg (fun q => det3 q a b) h
  have e2 := congrArg (fun q => det3 q c b) h
  simp only [det3_lin, det3_self12, det3_self13] at e1 e2
  rw [det3_swap12 c a b] at e2
  have hαγ : α = γ := by
    have : (α - γ) * det3 c a b = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact absurd h hd
  have hβ0 : β = 0 := by
    have : β * det3 c a b = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hd
  subst hβ0
  have hn := hz
  rw [mem_S2] at hn hc
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hc, mul_one] at hn
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hα] at hn
  simp [hn]

/-- Coordinates of the drawing of the star. -/
noncomputable def starPt : Fin 4 → E3
  | 0 => WithLp.toLp 2 ![2 / 3, 2 / 3, 1 / 3]
  | 1 => WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0, 0]
  | 2 => WithLp.toLp 2 ![0, 1, 0]
  | 3 => WithLp.toLp 2 ![0, 0, 1]

lemma norm_eq_one_of {x : E3} (h : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 = 1) : x ∈ S2 := by
  rw [mem_S2, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sqrt_eq_one]
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three] using h

lemma starPt_S2 (i : Fin 4) : starPt i ∈ S2 := by
  apply norm_eq_one_of
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [starPt]

lemma starPt_det (i j k : Fin 4) (hij : i ≠ j) (hjk : j ≠ k) (hik : i ≠ k) :
    det3 (starPt i) (starPt j) (starPt k) ≠ 0 := by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;> simp_all [det3, starPt]

lemma star3_genPos : GeneralPosition starPt := by
  refine ⟨starPt_S2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first
      | rfl
      | (have h0 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 0) h; have h1 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 1) h
         have h2 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 2) h; simp [starPt] at h0 h1 h2)
  · intro i j h
    have h0 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 0) h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 1) h
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q : E3 => q 2) h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [starPt] at h0 h1 h2 <;> linarith
  · rintro i j k hij hjk hik ⟨C, ⟨nrm, hn, rfl⟩, ⟨-, h1⟩, ⟨-, h2⟩, ⟨-, h3⟩⟩
    exact starPt_det i j k hij hjk hik ((det3_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨nrm, hn, h1, h2, h3⟩)

lemma star3_adj {u v : Fin 4} (h : star3.Adj u v) : (u = 0 ∧ v ≠ 0) ∨ (v = 0 ∧ u ≠ 0) := by
  revert u v; decide

theorem star3_gcThrackleable : GCThrackleable star3 := by
  refine ⟨starPt, fun _ => false, star3_genPos, ?_⟩
  intro u v w x h1 h2 hne
  simp only [edgeArc, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  have key : ∀ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ 0 → j ≠ 0 → i ≠ j →
      ∃! z, z ∈ shortArc (starPt 0) (starPt i) ∧ z ∈ shortArc (starPt 0) (starPt j) :=
    fun i j hi hj hij => shortArc_inter_shortArc (starPt_S2 0)
      (starPt_det 0 i j (Ne.symm hi) hij (Ne.symm hj))
  rcases star3_adj h1 with ⟨rfl, hv⟩ | ⟨rfl, hu⟩ <;> rcases star3_adj h2 with ⟨rfl, hx⟩ | ⟨rfl, hw⟩
  · exact key v x hv hx (fun h => hne (by rw [h]))
  · rw [shortArc_comm (starPt w)]; exact key v w hv hw (fun h => hne (by rw [h, Sym2.eq_swap]))
  · rw [shortArc_comm (starPt u)]; exact key u x hu hx (fun h => hne (by rw [h, Sym2.eq_swap]))
  · rw [shortArc_comm (starPt u), shortArc_comm (starPt w)]
    exact key u w hu hw (fun h => hne (by rw [h]))

lemma star3_isTree_degree3 : star3.IsTree ∧ star3.degree 0 = 3 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide⟩
  rw [isTree_iff_connected_and_card]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
    refine ⟨0, fun w => ?_⟩
    fin_cases w
    · rfl
    all_goals exact Adj.reachable (by decide)
  · simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← edgeFinset_card]
    decide +kernel

/-! ### The spider is not an augmented caterpillar -/

/-- Being at distance at most two, decided by search. -/
def near (a b : Fin 10) : Bool :=
  decide (a = b) || decide (spiderG.Adj a b) ||
    (List.finRange 10).any (fun m => decide (spiderG.Adj a m) && decide (spiderG.Adj m b))

/-- `ℓ` is at distance at least three from all vertices of `l`. -/
def far (ℓ : Fin 10) (l : List (Fin 10)) : Bool := l.all (fun t => !near ℓ t)

lemma spider_no_long_path : ∀ v0 v1 : Fin 10, spiderG.Adj v0 v1 → ∀ v2, spiderG.Adj v1 v2 →
    ∀ v3, spiderG.Adj v2 v3 → ∀ v4, spiderG.Adj v3 v4 → ∀ v5, spiderG.Adj v4 v5 →
    ∀ v6, spiderG.Adj v5 v6 → ∀ v7, spiderG.Adj v6 v7 → [v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7].Nodup →
    False := by
  decide +kernel

lemma spider_paths6 : ∀ v0 v1 : Fin 10, spiderG.Adj v0 v1 → ∀ v2, spiderG.Adj v1 v2 →
    ∀ v3, spiderG.Adj v2 v3 → ∀ v4, spiderG.Adj v3 v4 → ∀ v5, spiderG.Adj v4 v5 →
    ∀ v6, spiderG.Adj v5 v6 → [v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6].Nodup →
    (far 3 [v1, v2, v3, v4, v5] || far 6 [v1, v2, v3, v4, v5] || far 9 [v1, v2, v3, v4, v5])
      = true := by
  decide +kernel

lemma near_of_dist {a b : Fin 10} (hC : spiderG.Connected) (h : spiderG.dist a b ≤ 2) :
    near a b = true := by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hC.exists_walk_length_eq_dist a b
  rw [← hW] at h
  unfold near
  match W, h with
  | .nil, _ => simp
  | .cons h1 .nil, _ => simp [h1]
  | .cons (v := m) h1 (.cons h2 .nil), _ =>
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true, List.mem_finRange,
      true_and, Bool.and_eq_true]
    exact Or.inr ⟨m, h1, h2⟩
  | .cons _ (.cons _ (.cons _ _)), h => simp at h

theorem spider_not_augCat : ¬ IsAugmentedCaterpillar spiderG := by
  rintro ⟨hT, a, b, P, hP, hlong, -, hdist⟩
  have hC := hT.connected
  -- a path of length six
  let Q : spiderG.Walk 3 6 :=
    cons (v := 2) (by decide) (cons (v := 1) (by decide) (cons (v := 0) (by decide)
      (cons (v := 4) (by decide) (cons (v := 5) (by decide) (cons (by decide) nil)))))
  have h6 : 6 ≤ P.length := hlong 3 6 Q (by rw [isPath_def]; decide +kernel)
  have adj : ∀ s, s < P.length → spiderG.Adj (P.getVert s) (P.getVert (s + 1)) :=
    fun s hs => P.adj_getVert_succ hs
  have inj : ∀ s t, s ≤ P.length → t ≤ P.length → P.getVert s = P.getVert t → s = t :=
    fun s t hs ht h => hP.getVert_injOn hs ht h
  have nd : ∀ m, m ≤ P.length → (List.map P.getVert (List.range (m + 1))).Nodup := by
    intro m hm
    rw [List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on List.nodup_range]
    intro s hs t ht h
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hs ht
    exact inj s t (by omega) (by omega) h
  have hL : P.length = 6 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact spider_no_long_path _ _ (adj 0 (by omega)) _ (adj 1 (by omega)) _ (adj 2 (by omega))
      _ (adj 3 (by omega)) _ (adj 4 (by omega)) _ (adj 5 (by omega)) _ (adj 6 (by omega))
      (by simpa [List.range_succ] using nd 7 (by omega))
  have hfar := spider_paths6 _ _ (adj 0 (by omega)) _ (adj 1 (by omega)) _ (adj 2 (by omega))
      _ (adj 3 (by omega)) _ (adj 4 (by omega)) _ (adj 5 (by omega))
      (by simpa [List.range_succ] using nd 6 (by omega))
  have key : ∀ ℓ, far ℓ [P.getVert 1, P.getVert 2, P.getVert 3, P.getVert 4, P.getVert 5] = true →
      False := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨hw, hwa, hwb⟩, hd⟩ := hdist ℓ
    obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.1 hw
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h => hwa (by rw [h, getVert_zero])
    have ht6 : t ≠ 6 := fun h => hwb (by rw [h, ← hL, getVert_length])
    have hn := near_of_dist hC hd
    simp only [far, List.all_cons, List.all_nil, Bool.and_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
      Bool.not_eq_true'] at hℓ
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hℓ
    have : t = 1 ∨ t = 2 ∨ t = 3 ∨ t = 4 ∨ t = 5 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true] at hfar
  rcases hfar with (h | h) | h
  · exact key 3 h
  · exact key 6 h
  · exact key 9 h

/-! ### Why trees with at least three vertices -/

abbrev K2 : SimpleGraph (Fin 2) := graphOfEdges 2 [(0, 1)]

theorem K2_not_augCat : ¬ IsAugmentedCaterpillar K2 := by
  rintro ⟨-, a, b, P, hP, -, -, hdist⟩
  obtain ⟨w, ⟨hw, hwa, hwb⟩, -⟩ := hdist 0
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab
    cases P with
    | nil => simp at hw; exact hwa hw
    | cons h p => exact ((cons_isPath_iff _ _).1 hP).2 p.end_mem_support
  · have three : ∀ x y z : Fin 2, x ≠ y → x ≠ z → y ≠ z → False := by decide
    exact three w a b hwa hwb hab

theorem K2_gcThrackleable : GCThrackleable K2 := by
  refine ⟨fun i => starPt (Fin.castLE (by norm_num) i), fun _ => false, ⟨fun i => starPt_S2 _,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i j h
    have := star3_genPos.2.1 h
    exact Fin.castLE_injective _ this
  · intro i j; exact star3_genPos.2.2.1 _ _
  · intro i j k hij hjk hik; exfalso; revert i j k; decide
  · intro u v w x h1 h2 hne
    exfalso; apply hne
    revert u v w x; decide

end GC

#print axioms GC.star3_gcThrackleable
#print axioms GC.spider_not_augCat
#print axioms GC.K2_not_augCat
#print axioms GC.K2_gcThrackleable
#print axioms GC.antipodes_long_not_short
```
